Position: Accounts Manager

Position Summary
We are ProsperityWorks Solutions, a fast-growing B2B financial services firm focused on providing outsourced accounting and compliance support to small and mid-sized enterprises across India. The Accounts Manager will be responsible for owning end-to-end transactional accounting, statutory compliance, and vendor/employee payables processes for a portfolio of clients. This role requires strong practical knowledge of Tally and GST compliance, a clear understanding of TDS procedures, and the ability to manage timely Accounts Payable operations while ensuring accuracy and audit readiness. This is a Fully remote within India. role with opportunities to work closely with senior finance leaders and contribute to process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Client Accounting Operations
- Maintain accurate books of accounts for multiple client entities using Tally, ensuring timely recording of all financial transactions.
- Process and reconcile day-to-day accounting entries including purchase and sales ledgers, bank and cash entries, and expense allocation.
- Prepare monthly trial balances, ledger reconciliations, and supporting schedules for review.

Statutory Compliance & Reporting
- Ensure accurate and timely filing of GST returns, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B reconciliation and reporting of output/input tax details.
- Manage TDS compliance: calculation, deduction, deposit and filing of TDS returns as per statutory timelines.
- Coordinate with clients and internal teams to provide required documents and responses for GST and TDS audits.

Accounts Payable & Vendor Management
- Oversee the full Accounts Payable cycle: invoice verification, approvals, payment scheduling and vendor reconciliations.
- Maintain vendor master data, ensure accurate TDS applicability on vendor payments, and resolve vendor queries related to payments and statements.
- Implement controls to minimize duplicate payments and ensure adherence to payment terms.

Month-end Close & Financial Support
- Assist in month-end closing activities, ensuring that accounts payable, accruals and other cut-offs are recorded correctly.
- Support senior finance team in preparation of month-end packs and explanations of variances.
- Provide timely deliverables to auditors and support audit queries for the accounts under management.

Process Improvement & Systems
- Identify and propose process improvements to increase efficiency in transaction processing and compliance workflows.
- Work with cross-functional teams to implement best practices in accounting operations and maintain robust documentation.

Team & Stakeholder Management
- Coordinate with clients, vendors, internal operations and payroll teams to ensure seamless execution of accounting tasks.
- Mentor and provide guidance to junior accounting staff and review their work for accuracy and completeness.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 1+ years

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
- Tally
- GST
- Accounts Payable
- TDS

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- IFRS
- Financial Modeling
- SAP FICO
- Microsoft Excel

Success Metrics
- Timeliness and accuracy of GST and TDS filings (100% on-time compliance).
- Reduction in vendor payment discrepancies and days payable outstanding through improved processes.
- Quality of month-end deliverables: clean reconciliations and minimal audit queries.
- Accuracy and completeness of books maintained in Tally for assigned client portfolio.
- Positive client satisfaction ratings for responsiveness and issue resolution.

Location and Work Mode
- Fully remote within India.

ProsperityWorks Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We offer a collaborative remote work environment, competitive compensation aligned with experience, and professional development opportunities in accounting and finance.
